note: Workflow audit 2026-08-13: all 108 ministry primary objectives vs platform grades 3-5 content, plus figure-first pedagogy audit of the three existing courses.

results.evidence: Platform grade 3 unit numbers-to-1000 (lessons hundreds-tens-and-ones, reading-and-writing-numbers, comparing-and-ordering, rounding-to-the-nearest-ten with number-line marking) subsumes reading/writing/comparing/ordering numbers to 100 and placing them on a number line; also g4 numbers-to-10000/comparing-and-ordering. Ordinal 'дугаарлах' is only implicit but the objective's substance is fully present.

Estimating a QUANTITY of objects in tens and checking by counting ('аравтаар баримжаалан хэлж, түүнийгээ тоолж шалгах') appears nowhere; every 'estimate' hit in g4/g5 (numbers-to-10000/rounding, g5 whole-numbers-and-place-value, addition-and-subtraction) is rounding or estimating the RESULT of arithmetic, not sizing a collection of objects.

The mechanics of completing/breaking a ten are taught inside column arithmetic — g3 addition-and-subtraction-to-1000 (column-addition 'with a carry', column-subtraction 'with a break') and g5 addition-and-subtraction mental strategies ('making tens and hundreds') — but the within-20 fact work itself, '10, 20-ийн бүтцийг цээжээр хэлэх' (recalling the bonds of 10 and 20 by heart), is taught nowhere; the platform assumes single-digit facts at entry.

Adding/subtracting within 100 without regrouping is subsumed by g3 addition-and-subtraction-to-1000 (adding-tens-and-hundreds, column-addition, column-subtraction — both no-regroup and regroup cases inside 1000) and g4 addition-and-subtraction.

Even/odd via pairing and the ones-digit rule is explicitly taught in g4 numbers-to-10000/number-patterns ('pairing always leaves one out', 'only the ones digit votes'), with the pairing idea echoed in g3 division-sharing-and-grouping/sharing-equally; doubles (equal-addend sums) are taught as the two times table in g3 multiplication-first-facts/tables-of-2-5-and-10 ('the two times table is doubling').

g3 addition-and-subtraction-to-1000/fact-families-and-missing-numbers teaches writing the four facts of a family (commutativity of addition in action) and finding the unknown member; expressions-and-values and true/false comparison signs run through g3 numbers-to-1000/comparing-and-ordering; zero behaviour is taught in g3 multiplication-first-facts/times-one-times-zero-and-stories. The addition +0 property is not named but is trivially embedded.

g3 numbers-to-1000/counting-in-steps (steps of 2, 5, 10, 100 up and down), g3 shapes-sides-and-corners/shape-patterns (repeating vs growing patterns in shapes), and g4 numbers-to-10000/number-patterns (name the step, continue the sequence).

Solving and checking simple word problems is taught (g3 addition-and-subtraction-to-1000/word-problems — join-or-split, 1-2 steps, check the answer against the story; g3 division-sharing-and-grouping/choosing-the-operation), but the composing half — 'өгсөн загвар, зураг дүрслэлд тохирох энгийн бодлого зохиох' (making up one's own problem to fit a given model/picture) — is absent everywhere.

Clock and hour taught in g3 measuring-time-and-money/telling-the-time and g4 measurement-time-and-money/reading-the-clock; day/week/month/year and event durations in g4 calendar-and-duration. Missing named piece: 'улирал' (seasons) as a time unit is taught nowhere (a single incidental 'summer' in a g4 word problem), and picture-sequence ordering of events has no counterpart.

g3 measuring-time-and-money/counting-money (totalling tögrög notes, making change, receipt check) and g4 measurement-time-and-money/togrog-money ('make one amount in different ways, give change') — exactly the задлах/бүхэлдэх substance.

g3 measuring-time-and-money: heavier-lighter-holds-more (comparing masses on a balance, capacities by filling, comparison vocabulary), measuring-in-centimetres (writing lengths in cm), metres-and-comparing; reinforced by g4 measurement-time-and-money/length and mass-and-capacity.

Naming triangle/quadrilateral/circle and shape-making are taught (g3 shapes-sides-and-corners/naming-flat-shapes; g4 shapes-and-symmetry/two-d-shapes) and fold-test symmetry is taught (g4 shapes-and-symmetry/line-symmetry), but 'цэг, хэрчим, тахир шугам' (point, line segment, broken line) are never named or taught — no hit for segment/broken line in any grade 3-5 file.

No lesson anywhere in grades 3-5 teaches spatial position/direction/movement vocabulary for locating objects ('орон зай, чиглэл, хөдөлгөөнтэй холбоотой үг хэллэг'); grep hits for left/right/above are incidental phrasing such as comparing digits 'from the left'.

Classifying by one or two attributes is taught through g3 shapes-sides-and-corners/sorting-shapes (sort by a stated rule, one shape in different groups under different rules) and g4 shapes-and-symmetry/sorting-quadrilaterals, but the 'Карроллын диаграмм' representation itself appears nowhere in grades 3-5.

g3 tallies-and-picture-graphs (making-a-table — collecting counts into a table with totals; picture-graphs — one-for-one pictograms read and drawn; answering-questions-from-data) plus g4 data-and-pictographs (frequency tables, pictographs with keys).

coverage.summary: Ministry grade 1 content lives overwhelmingly in PLATFORM grade 3 (numbers-to-1000, addition-and-subtraction-to-1000, measuring-time-and-money, shapes-sides-and-corners, tallies-and-picture-graphs), with a few pieces landing in platform grade 4 (even/odd in numbers-to-10000/number-patterns, fold-test symmetry, calendar-and-duration) — i.e., the platform's numbering runs roughly two years above the ministry's for this band. Of the 15 objectives, 8 are covered, 5 partial, and 2 missing; the covered core is number work, arithmetic, money, measurement comparison, and pictogram data. The genuine gaps are the pre-formal/kinesthetic strand the platform never picks up: estimating object quantities by tens (1.1б), spatial position/direction vocabulary (1.3б), Carroll diagrams, point/segment/broken-line naming, seasons as a time unit, within-20 fact fluency (bonds of 10/20), and having students compose their own problems.

results.evidence: Grade 3 unit numbers-to-1000: lessons hundreds-tens-and-ones, reading-and-writing-numbers, comparing-and-ordering — place value to 1000, reading/writing, comparing/ordering, with number-line marking present in the unit (grep 'number line' hits 3/numbers-to-1000.json).

Grade 3 numbers-to-1000/rounding-to-the-nearest-ten plus grade 4 numbers-to-10000/rounding (spine blurb: 'rounding to 10 and 100'), both built on the number line — rounding to tens and hundreds is taught.

Grade 3 unit fractions-halves-and-quarters: lessons equal-parts, halves-and-quarters ('Equal parts as the promise every fraction makes, naming halves, thirds and quarters'); reinforced in grade 4 fractions-parts-of-a-whole/unit-fractions.

Grade 3 addition-and-subtraction-to-1000: adding-tens-and-hundreds (which place-value column moves, trading up when a column fills), column-addition, column-subtraction; expanded-form partitioning explicit in grade 4 numbers-to-10000/place-value.

Grade 3 multiplication-first-facts (equal-groups repeated addition → product, tables of 2/5/10 and 3/4) and division-sharing-and-grouping (sharing, grouping); remainder division (үлдэгдэлтэй хуваах) is deliberately deferred from grade 3 but taught in grade 4 division-and-sharing/remainders.

Grade 3 addition-and-subtraction-to-1000/adding-tens-and-hundreds (mental tens/hundreds sums incl. trading up to the next hundred), grade 4 addition-and-subtraction/mental-strategies (make-ten, compensation), grade 4 division-and-sharing/halving-and-doubling (double/halve mentally), grade 5 whole-numbers-and-place-value/estimating-with-rounded-numbers (round-then-add).

Commutativity taught (grade 3 multiplication-first-facts/arrays-and-the-turnaround, grade 4 arrays-and-turnaround), distributive multiplication of a sum taught (grade 5 multiplication-and-division/multiplying-by-one-digit 'the distributive idea'), and compare-without-calculating items exist (grade 3 division-sharing-and-grouping tryIt). Absent: 'Үйлдлийн дараалал тогтоон тоон илэрхийллийн утгыг олох' — no lesson anywhere in grades 3–5 teaches order of operations in mixed-operation expressions (no brackets/order-of-operations content in any unit).

Grade 3 addition-and-subtraction-to-1000/fact-families-and-missing-numbers, grade 4 addition-and-subtraction/missing-numbers, grade 5 addition-and-subtraction/fact-families-and-missing-numbers — expressing one member of an operation via the others and making statements true.

Grade 3 numbers-to-1000/counting-in-steps (steps of 2, 5, 10 and 100), grade 4 numbers-to-10000/number-patterns (skip-counting patterns), grade 3 shapes-sides-and-corners/shape-patterns (repeating shape/object patterns).

Solving word problems with a stepwise plan and answer-checking is taught (grade 3 addition-and-subtraction-to-1000/word-problems 'check that the answer makes sense', grade 4 word-problems, grade 5 multi-step-word-problems). Absent: 'бодлогыг хавтан загвараар дүрслэх' — no bar/strip-model diagramming anywhere (grep 'bar model' = 0 hits) — and 'өгсөн загвар, бичвэрт тохирох энгийн бодлого зохиох' — students are never asked to compose their own problems.

Time units and comparison (grade 5 measurement-and-units/units-of-time, grade 4 calendar-and-duration), analog reading to o'clock/half past (grade 3 measuring-time-and-money/telling-the-time) and to the quarter hour (grade 4 measurement-time-and-money/reading-the-clock), duration/elapsed time (grade 5 elapsed-time). Absent: 'аналоги цагийг ... 5 минутын нарийвчлалтай унших' — analog clock reading stops at the quarter hour; no lesson reads the face at 5-minute precision (elapsed-time uses digital-style notation only).

Grade 3 measuring-time-and-money/counting-money ('counting tögrög notes and change') and grade 4 measurement-time-and-money/togrog-money ('counting tögrög and making change') — decomposing/combining denominations and computing change.

Length/mass/capacity measuring, reading scales, comparing, cm/m/kg/l taught in grade 3 measuring-time-and-money (measuring-in-centimetres, metres-and-comparing, heavier-lighter-holds-more), grade 4 (length, mass-and-capacity), grade 5 measurement-and-units (units-of-length incl. mm, mass-and-capacity); perimeter of shapes in grade 5 geometry-shapes-and-area/perimeter. Absent: 'уртын хэмжээг уламжлалт нэгжээр (сөөм, төө, тохой, алд, дэлэм, алхам) баримжаалах' — traditional Mongolian length units appear nowhere (greps for сөөм/төө/тохой/алд and English equivalents all 0 hits); the дм (decimetre) unit is also never used.

Grade 3 shapes-sides-and-corners (naming-flat-shapes, square-corners, solid shapes, constructions via shape-patterns), grade 4 shapes-and-symmetry (two-d-shapes names pentagon/hexagon/quadrilateral by side count, right-angles, line-symmetry via 'the fold test', three-d-solids), grade 5 geometry-shapes-and-area/angles (angle as turn between two rays).

Nowhere on the platform: no lesson in grades 3–5 teaches describing object locations or naming/writing a cell's position in a grid with lettered columns and numbered rows (greps for 'grid reference', 'lettered column', 'coordinate'-position content, battleship-style B3 references all return nothing; 'grid' hits are incidental, e.g. square corners 'the squares of a grid').

Classifying by attributes is taught — grade 3 shapes-sides-and-corners/sorting-shapes (sort by a stated rule, one shape in several groups) and grade 4 shapes-and-symmetry/sorting-quadrilaterals — but 'Карроллын диаграмм хэрэглэн' is absent: the Carroll-diagram representation itself (one/two-criteria yes/no table) appears nowhere in grades 3–5 (grep 'Carroll'/'two-way' = 0 hits).

Grade 3 tallies-and-picture-graphs: tally-marks, making-a-table, picture-graphs, block-graphs, answering-questions-from-data — collecting data, recording in tables, representing as picture graphs and interpreting; extended in grade 4 data-and-pictographs and grade 5 data-and-graphs.

Nowhere on the platform: no grade 3–5 lesson or practice teaches forming pairs/combinations from one or two sets (greps for 'how many ways', 'combination', 'pair up', 'possible pairs' return only false positives such as 'how many ways the whole is cut' in fractions).

coverage.summary: Ministry grade 2 content lives overwhelmingly in platform Grade 3 (numbers to 1000, tens/hundreds addition, first multiplication and division facts, halves and quarters, cm/m/kg/l measuring, o'clock and half past, tögrög, tallies and picture graphs), with Grade 4 back-filling deliberately deferred pieces (remainders, quarter-hour clock, pentagon/hexagon, fold-test symmetry) and Grade 5 supplying perimeter, mm and angles — so platform Grade 3 ≈ ministry Grade 2, a one-grade offset. Of the 18 objectives, 11 are covered, 5 partial, 2 missing; the partials fail on specific named ministry tools rather than topics: order of operations (2.1ж), bar-model diagrams and problem-composing (2.1к), 5-minute analog clock reading (2.2а), traditional Mongolian length units сөөм/төө/тохой/алд/дэлэм (2.2в), and Carroll diagrams (2.4а). The two outright gaps are 2.3б (describing location and grid positions with lettered columns/numbered rows) and 2.4в (forming pairs from one or two sets), which have no counterpart anywhere in grades 3–5.

results.evidence: Platform grade 4 unit numbers-to-10000: lessons reading-and-writing-numbers, place-value, comparing-and-ordering cover naming place values to 10 000, reading/writing, number-line marking, comparing and ordering (the file teaches expanded form and uses number lines).

Rounding on marked number lines: grade 3 numbers-to-1000/rounding-to-the-nearest-ten, grade 4 numbers-to-10000/rounding (nearest 10 and 100), grade 5 whole-numbers-and-place-value/rounding-whole-numbers (nearest hundred and thousand).

Negative numbers taught nowhere in grades 3-5; grade 5 addition-and-subtraction explicitly says 'Negative numbers arrive in later grades'. No thermometer/number-line-past-zero content; 'сөрөг тоог унших, бичих, жиших, эрэмбэлэх' is entirely absent.

Grade 4 fractions-parts-of-a-whole (unit-fractions, non-unit-fractions, comparing-fractions with like denominators) and grade 5 fractions-first-steps/what-a-fraction-is places fractions as points on the number line; denominators through 8 taught, tenths in grade 5 decimals-first-steps.

Expanded-form partitioning in grade 4 numbers-to-10000/place-value and grade 5 whole-numbers-and-place-value/the-value-of-a-digit; add/subtract within 10 000 in grade 4 addition-and-subtraction (column + mental-strategies); estimation in grade 5 estimating-with-rounded-numbers and mental-addition-and-subtraction.

×10/×100 taught (grade 4 tables-2-5-and-10, grade 5 multiplying-by-two-digits 'the shift', trailing zeros; ÷10/÷100 via grade 5 measurement-and-units conversions); remainder division in grade 4 remainders and grade 5 division-with-remainders; doubling/halving in grade 4 halving-and-doubling; times-as-many comparison in grade 5 data-and-graphs. MISSING piece: 'нэг тоо нөгөө тооноосоо хэд дахин бага (их) үед эдгээр хоёр тооны нийлбэрээр (зөрөөгөөр) тоо тус бүрийг олох' — finding each of two numbers from their sum/difference plus a times-relationship is not taught as a problem type anywhere.

Number sentences/equalities via fact families (grade 3 fact-families-and-missing-numbers), inequalities via comparing lessons (< / > in all three grades' comparing-and-ordering), commutative/associative properties of addition used to compute and check in grade 5 addition-and-subtraction/mental-addition-and-subtraction, multiplication commutativity in grade 4 arrays-and-turnaround.

Expressing one member of an operation through the others and finding it: grade 3 addition-and-subtraction-to-1000/fact-families-and-missing-numbers, grade 4 addition-and-subtraction/missing-numbers, grade 5 addition-and-subtraction/fact-families-and-missing-numbers (inverse relationship, missing-number equations, checking).

Fraction of a quantity: grade 3 fractions-halves-and-quarters/a-fraction-of-a-set, grade 4 fractions-parts-of-a-whole/fraction-of-a-set, grade 5 what-a-fraction-is (3/4 of 12); adding/subtracting like-denominator fractions: grade 5 fractions-first-steps/adding-and-subtracting-like-denominators.

Skip counting by a constant: grade 3 numbers-to-1000/counting-in-steps; number patterns with missing terms: grade 4 numbers-to-10000/number-patterns; shape/object patterns and continuing them: grade 3 shapes-sides-and-corners/shape-patterns.

Multi-step word problems with plan-like event lists, operation choice, and checking against estimates/inverse operations are taught (grade 3 word-problems and choosing-the-operation, grade 4 word-problems, grade 5 multi-step-word-problems + fact-families checking). MISSING pieces: 'хавтан загвар, хэрчмээр дүрслэх' — bar-model/segment-diagram representation of problems appears nowhere ('bar model' has zero matches) — and '2-3 алхамтай өгүүлбэртэй бодлого зохиох' (students composing their own problems) is not asked.

Seconds/minutes/hours/days/weeks in grade 5 measurement-and-units/units-of-time, months/years in grade 4 calendar-and-duration, elapsed time in grade 5 elapsed-time and grade 3/4 clock lessons. MISSING piece: 'жаран, зуун' — the 60-year cycle and the century as time units are never taught (century appears only in incidental fun-fact prose about the metre bar).

mm/cm/m/km in grade 5 units-of-length (and grade 3 measuring-in-centimetres teaches reading a scale from the zero mark), g/kg/t and ml/l in grade 4 and grade 5 mass-and-capacity, unit conversion throughout grade 5 measurement-and-units, perimeter in grade 5 geometry-shapes-and-area/perimeter. MISSING pieces: the units 'дм' (decimetre) and 'ц' (centner) appear nowhere in the three grades.

Area by counting unit squares and expressing in cm² is taught in grade 5 geometry-shapes-and-area/area-of-rectangles (unit square, cm² both present). MISSING piece: 'кубын дэлгээсийн талбайн хэмжээг олох' — finding the area of a cube's net is absent; nets are not taught anywhere ('net' has no geometric matches).

Grade 5 geometry-shapes-and-area/angles teaches right/acute/obtuse angles and perpendicular crossings; triangles-and-quadrilaterals teaches polygons and parallel sides (parallelograms, trapezoid's parallel pair); circles named in grade 3 naming-flat-shapes and grade 4 two-d-shapes; symmetry axes in grade 4 shapes-and-symmetry/line-symmetry.

The cube itself is recognized and described in grade 3 shapes-sides-and-corners/solid-shapes and grade 4 shapes-and-symmetry/three-d-solids (faces/edges/vertices). MISSING piece: 'түүний дэлгээсийг таних, өгсөн дэлгээсээр нь бүтээх' — recognizing the cube's net and building the cube from a given net is taught nowhere.

No location/position/direction content anywhere in grades 3-5: no maps, routes, grids-as-location, compass directions, or describing paths ('гэр, сургууль орчны зам... байршлыг хэлэх, заасан байршилд хүрэх зам, чиглэлийг тодорхойлох, шилжүүлэх'). The only 'position'/'grid'/'coordinate' hits are incidental (pattern positions, square corners of a grid, one symmetry exercise using coordinates).

Classifying objects by attributes is taught in grade 3 shapes-sides-and-corners/sorting-shapes (sort by a stated rule, one shape in several groups) and grade 4 sorting-quadrilaterals. MISSING piece: 'Карролл, Эйлер-Веннийн диаграмм' — Carroll and Euler-Venn diagrams as classification tools appear nowhere (zero matches; the one 'venn' string is the word 'evenness').

Full data cycle: grade 3 tallies-and-picture-graphs (tally-marks, making-a-table, picture-graphs, block-graphs, answering-questions-from-data), grade 4 data-and-pictographs (tables-and-totals, pictographs, bar-charts, questions-of-data), grade 5 data-and-graphs (tally-charts-and-tables, bar-graphs).

Tree diagrams for counting possibilities ('модны загвар хэрэглэн боломжийг тооцоолох') exist nowhere in grades 3-5: 'tree diagram', 'possibilit-', 'outcome', and combinatorics content all have zero matches.

coverage.summary: Ministry grade 3 content lives mostly in PLATFORM GRADE 4 (numbers to 10 000, rounding to 10/100, first remainders, tables to 10), with several strands only reached at platform grade 5 (acute/obtuse angles and perpendicularity, area in cm², fractions on the number line, seconds and unit conversion) — the platform runs roughly one grade number above the ministry's, exactly as its spine comments intend. Of the 20 objectives, 10 are covered, 7 are partial, and 3 are missing outright: negative numbers (3.1в, explicitly deferred 'to later grades'), location/direction/routes (3.3в), and tree-diagram possibility counting (3.4в). The recurring partial-gap themes are ministry-specific apparatus the English-sourced curriculum never picked up: Carroll/Euler-Venn diagrams, cube nets and their area, bar-model problem representation, sum-and-times-relationship number problems, the дм and ц units, and the жаран/зуун (60-year cycle/century) time units.

results.evidence: Platform grade 5 unit whole-numbers-and-place-value: lessons reading-and-writing-large-numbers (numbers to the millions, digit groups), the-value-of-a-digit, comparing-and-ordering-numbers, rounding-whole-numbers (tens through hundred-thousands), estimating-with-rounded-numbers.

Negative numbers appear nowhere in grades 3-5; grade 5 addition-and-subtraction explicitly states 'Negative numbers arrive in later grades'. First taught in the platform's grade 7 rational-number-operations, outside the primary band.

Grade 5 fractions-first-steps: lesson improper-fractions-and-mixed-numbers (read both forms, convert both ways explicitly via division with remainders — quotient = wholes, remainder = pieces), plus comparing-fractions and number-line work in the same unit.

Grade 5 decimals-first-steps: tenths-and-hundredths (decimal place value, two decimal places), decimals-and-fractions (denominator-10/100 fractions as decimals), comparing-and-ordering-decimals, rounding-and-measuring-with-decimals (round to nearest whole); number line used in the unit.

Grade 5 addition-and-subtraction: adding-with-regrouping, subtracting-with-regrouping (multi-digit inside the millions band), mental-addition-and-subtraction (compensation 'round, then repay' for numbers near tens/hundreds, making tens and hundreds).

Multiplying multi-digit by 1- and 2-digit and dividing by 1-digit are taught (grade 5 multiplication-and-division: multiplying-by-one-digit, multiplying-by-two-digits, division-with-remainders, long-division; grade 4 times-tables-and-multiplication/multiply-bigger-numbers). Absent: division by two-digit divisors ('хоёр оронтой тоогоор ... хуваах' — long-division is one-digit divisors only), writing a number as a product of factors ('хоёр оронтой тоог хэд хэдэн тооны үржвэр хэлбэртэй бичих'), and divisibility tests ('тооны 2, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100-д хуваагдах шинжийг хэрэглэн цээжээр тооцоолох').

Operation-member relationships, properties and equations are taught (grade 4 addition-and-subtraction/missing-numbers box equations with inverse-and-check; grade 5 addition-and-subtraction/fact-families-and-missing-numbers; commutativity in arrays-and-turnaround lessons). Absent: inequalities — 'тэнцэтгэл бишийг бодох, шалгах' appears nowhere in grades 3-5.

Grade 5 fractions-first-steps/adding-and-subtracting-like-denominators (like-denominator add/subtract, sums past one whole converted to mixed numbers such as 1 1/2, subtracting a fraction from a whole number by renaming wholes); part problems via grade 4 fractions-parts-of-a-whole/fraction-of-a-set and grade 3 a-fraction-of-a-set.

No ratio, proportion, or scale-drawing (enlarge/reduce) content anywhere in grades 3-5 — every 'ratio' grep hit is the substring of 'operation'; no dividing a quantity in a given ratio, equal ratios, or unknown proportion member. Proportionality first appears in the platform's grade 7 spine.

Decimal addition and subtraction fully taught (grade 5 decimals-first-steps/adding-and-subtracting-decimals: aligning the point, padding, subtracting from whole numbers). Absent: the mental complements drill — 'нийлбэр нь 1 эсвэл 10 байх хоёр аравтын бутархайг цээжээр хэлэх' (decimal pairs making 1 or 10) is not found in the unit.
Grade 4 numbers-to-10000/number-patterns (skip counting by 25s/50s/100s, find the step by subtracting neighbours, continue and describe patterns) and grade 3 numbers-to-1000/counting-in-steps.

Plan-and-check multi-step problem solving is taught (grade 5 addition-and-subtraction/multi-step-word-problems with estimate-checking, measurement-and-units/measurement-word-problems, choosing-the-operation lessons in grades 3-5) and simple graphs are interpreted (data-and-graphs/line-graphs). Absent: proportional-relationship problems via tables and graphs — 'Пропорционал хамаарлын бодлогыг хүснэгт, хялбар графикаар илэрхийлэх' has no counterpart in grades 3-5.

Grade 5 measurement-and-units/elapsed-time (elapsed time by counting up through round hours, end times from start + duration, 'read simple timetables'); grade 4 measurement-time-and-money/calendar-and-duration.

Grade 5 measurement-and-units: units-of-length, mass-and-capacity (measure, compare, express one unit in another incl. mixed forms), units-of-time with fraction-of-an-hour amounts; decimals-first-steps/rounding-and-measuring-with-decimals (m-cm via decimals); geometry-shapes-and-area/perimeter includes decimal side lengths (e.g. 1.2 m), with decimal measures (4.5 m, 12.7 cm, 3.05 m) throughout g5 geometry/measurement.

No volume of a rectangular parallelepiped by counting unit cubes and no cubic-centimetre (см.куб) content anywhere in grades 3-5 — greps for volume/cubic return only an incidental word-problem phrase; capacity in litres is taught but not unit-cube volume.

Area in square units is taught well (grade 5 geometry-shapes-and-area/area-of-rectangles — unit-square counting, square metres, area-vs-perimeter units — and composite-areas). Absent: 'палетка хэрэглэн дүрсийн талбайн хэмжээг олох' (the palette/transparent-grid method for arbitrary figures) and the full unit set — дм.кв and км.кв never appear (only square units/square metres).
Surface area of a rectangular parallelepiped is nowhere in grades 3-5; grade 4 shapes-and-symmetry/three-d-solids counts a cuboid's faces but never computes 'гадаргуугийн талбайн хэмжээ'.

Measuring and classifying angles in degrees is taught (grade 5 geometry-shapes-and-area/angles: degrees, right-angle benchmark, angles on a line and around a point). Absent: the protractor itself — 'транспортироор хэмжих' (no protractor anywhere in 3-5) — and recognising regular polygons ('зөв олон өнцөгтийг таних').

Recognising the cuboid and cylinder is taught (grade 4 shapes-and-symmetry/three-d-solids names cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone etc. with faces/edges/vertices; grade 3 solid-shapes). Absent: building them from nets — 'өгсөн дэлгээсээр нь бүтээх' — no net/unfolding content in grades 3-5.

No reading of area plans or route maps and no coordinate work — 'координатын хавтгайн I мөч' (quadrant I point coordinates: reading, writing, plotting) appears nowhere in grades 3-5; the only 'coordinate' hit is an incidental figure note.

Line symmetry is taught as recognition (grade 4 shapes-and-symmetry/line-symmetry: fold test, drawing mirror lines, counting lines of symmetry). Absent: performing the transformation — 'тэгш хэмээр хувиргах', i.e. drawing the reflected image of a figure across an axis parallel to a side — no such construction tasks exist.
Parallel translation ('параллелээр зөөх') of a segment or right triangle is nowhere in grades 3-5; all 'translat' hits are about translating numerals into words.

Rotating a segment or right triangle 90° clockwise about a vertex and drawing the image is nowhere in grades 3-5; grade 4 right-angles treats a quarter turn only as an angle size, never as a figure transformation.

Classifying objects by attributes is taught (grade 3 shapes-sides-and-corners/sorting-shapes — sort by a stated rule, one shape in different groups under different rules; grade 4 shapes-and-symmetry/sorting-quadrilaterals). Absent: the diagram tools themselves — 'Карролл, Эйлер-Веннийн диаграмм' — no Carroll or Venn diagram appears anywhere (the one 'venn' grep hit is the substring of 'evenness'), and no structured two-attribute classification.

Grade 4 data-and-pictographs (tally-marks, tables-and-totals collecting data, pictographs with keys, bar-charts, questions-of-data) and grade 5 data-and-graphs (bar-graphs: reading values against a scale, comparing by difference and multiple, choosing a sensible scale; line-graphs interpreting simple graphs of change).

Determining possible vs impossible events by observation/experiment ('боломжтой, боломжгүй үзэгдэл') is nowhere — no probability/chance/likelihood content in grades 3-5; every 'impossible'/'chance' grep hit is incidental prose.
Counting the number of possibilities ('боломжийн тоог тооцоолох', elementary combinatorics) is nowhere in grades 3-5 — no how-many-ways/arrangement/outcome-counting content.

coverage.summary: Ministry grade 4's content lives overwhelmingly in PLATFORM grade 5 (numbers to the millions, mixed numbers, decimals, angle degrees, perimeter/area, timetables, graph scales), with platform grade 4 supplying only the data-collection and 3-D-solid-recognition pieces — the platform's grade numbering runs roughly one year behind the ministry's. Of 27 objectives, 9 are covered, 9 partial, and 9 missing. The gaps cluster in geometry transformations and space (reflection-as-transformation, translation, 90° rotation, quadrant-I coordinates and plans/route maps, nets, unit-cube volume, cuboid surface area, палетка), plus negative numbers, ratio/proportion/scale, inequalities, divisibility tests, Carroll/Venn diagrams, and the whole possible-impossible-events/counting-possibilities strand.

results.evidence: Multi-digit read/write/compare/order/round fully taught in platform grade 5 whole-numbers-and-place-value (reading-and-writing-large-numbers, the-value-of-a-digit, comparing-and-ordering-numbers, rounding-whole-numbers). Missing piece: "ром тоог унших, бичих" — Roman numerals appear only as a historical aside in grade 4 numbers-to-10000 ("Roman numerals had no places..."), never taught as a read/write skill.

Negative numbers ("Сөрөг тоог... тоолох, тоон шулуун хэрэглэн зөрөөг олох") are nowhere taught; grade 5 addition-and-subtraction explicitly states "Negative numbers arrive in later grades." No number-line work with negatives in any of grades 3-5.

Grade 5 fractions-first-steps: equivalent-fractions (renaming when one denominator divides the other), comparing-fractions (same-numerator rule, half/one benchmarks, ordering), with number lines used throughout (10 number-line references in the unit).

Grade 5 decimals-first-steps: tenths-and-hundredths (place value), comparing-and-ordering-decimals (extends to thousandths, e.g. ordering 0.720/0.700/0.270/0.702), rounding-and-measuring-with-decimals, decimals-and-fractions; number-line placement included.
Grade 5 addition-and-subtraction: adding-with-regrouping, subtracting-with-regrouping, mental-addition-and-subtraction (numbers near hundreds/thousands, estimation checks with rounded numbers).

Multi-digit multiplication and division taught in grade 5 multiplication-and-division (multiplying-by-one-digit, multiplying-by-two-digits, division-with-remainders, long-division). Missing pieces: "2, 4, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100-д хуваагдах шинж" (divisibility rules) and "хоёр тооны ерөнхий хуваагч, ерөнхий хуваагдагчийг олох" (common divisors/multiples of two numbers) — neither appears anywhere; 'factor' occurs only in the distributive-property sense.

Using operation-member relationships to solve/check missing-number equations is taught: grade 5 addition-and-subtraction fact-families-and-missing-numbers ("is the box the WHOLE or a PART"), grade 4 addition-and-subtraction missing-numbers. Missing piece: "тэнцэтгэл биш" — solving/composing inequalities is not taught anywhere.

Fraction addition/subtraction taught only with LIKE denominators (grade 5 fractions-first-steps adding-and-subtracting-like-denominators, which calls mixing denominators "the one unforgivable move"). Missing piece: the objective's defining case "ижил бус хуваарьтай энгийн бутархайг нэмэх, хасах" (unlike denominators where one divides the other), even though equivalent-fractions provides the renaming prerequisite.

"Харьцаа, пропорц, масштаб" (ratio, proportion, scale) appear nowhere in grades 3-5; all grep hits for 'ratio' are substrings of 'operation'. Proportional reasoning first appears in the platform's grade 7 spine (Proportional Relationships).

Percent ("Процентыг тэмдэглэх... хэдэн процент болохыг олох") is not taught; grade 5 fractions-first-steps mentions it only as a forward-looking aside ("When you meet percents next year, you already know the whole trick") — no notation practice, no finding 50%/25%/20%/10%/1% of a quantity anywhere.

Adding/subtracting decimals taught (grade 5 decimals-first-steps adding-and-subtracting-decimals); ×100/÷100 place shifts appear inside metric conversions (rounding-and-measuring-with-decimals: 1.35 m = 135 cm, one 2.5 × 1000 example). Missing piece: "аравтын бутархайг 10, 100, 1000, нэгжээр үржүүлэх, хуваах" as a taught skill — no systematic multiply/divide of decimals by 10/100/1000 or by whole numbers outside conversion contexts.

Grade 4 numbers-to-10000 number-patterns (find the step by subtracting neighbours, continue and describe patterns) and grade 3 numbers-to-1000 counting-in-steps; grade 3 shapes-sides-and-corners shape-patterns adds figure patterns.

General multi-step problem solving and guess-and-check estimation are taught (grade 5 addition-and-subtraction multi-step-word-problems; whole-numbers-and-place-value estimating-with-rounded-numbers covers "асуудлын хариуг таамаглан шалгах"). Missing pieces: "процент, масштаб бүхий бодлогыг бодох" (no percent or scale problems exist) and "тоон таавар, логик бодлого бодох" (no number-puzzle/logic-problem strand).

Calendar-based duration computation (цаг тооны бичиг = calendar) taught in grade 4 measurement-time-and-money calendar-and-duration (weeks/months/365-day trades, durations from calendar); grade 5 measurement-and-units units-of-time and elapsed-time (counting up through round hours, end times, timetables).

Grade 5 measurement-and-units (units-of-length, mass-and-capacity, measurement-word-problems with convert-first method, fraction-of-an-hour amounts), decimals-first-steps rounding-and-measuring-with-decimals (measures expressed and converted as decimals, 1.35 m = 135 cm), and perimeter in geometry-shapes-and-area perimeter.

Volume of cube/cuboid in см.куб/дм.куб/м.куб is nowhere taught; the word 'volume' appears once in grade 5 multiplication-and-division only inside a canal word problem, not as a measurement topic. No cubic units anywhere in grades 3-5.

Area in cm², dm², m² taught in grade 5 geometry-shapes-and-area (area-of-rectangles, composite-areas; includes an 81 dm² exercise). Missing piece: the units "км.кв, а, га" (square kilometre, are, hectare) never appear.

Grade 5 geometry-shapes-and-area: triangles-and-quadrilaterals classifies triangles by sides (equilateral/isosceles/scalene) and angles, and teaches the fixed angle budgets "triangles get 180° ... quadrilaterals get 360°" with missing-angle problems; angles lesson establishes 180°/360°.

Recognition of solids including the square pyramid, cube, cuboid with faces/edges/vertices taught in grade 4 shapes-and-symmetry three-d-solids (and grade 3 solid-shapes). Missing piece: "өгсөн дэлгээсээр нь бүтээх" — nets appear nowhere (no 'net' content in any grade), and prisms are never named as a class.

No plan drawings or route maps ("план зураг, аяллын замын зураг") and no first-quadrant coordinate work ("координатын хавтгайн I мөч") anywhere; the only 'coordinates' hit is a figure caption note in grade 4 shapes-and-symmetry, not instruction.

Line-symmetry recognition taught in grade 4 shapes-and-symmetry line-symmetry (fold test, drawing mirror lines, counting lines of symmetry). Missing piece: "тэгш хэмтэй хувиргах, бүтээл хийх" — actually performing the reflection (constructing/completing a figure's mirror image across an axis, making symmetric designs) is not taught.
Translation of figures ("дүрсийг параллелээр зөөх") appears nowhere; 'slide' hits in grade 4 are only about fitting a page corner into an angle to test right angles.
Rotating a right triangle 90° about a vertex ("нэг оройн хувьд 90° эргүүлэх") — no rotation content of any kind exists in grades 3-5 (zero 'rotat' hits).

Classifying objects by attributes taught in grade 3 shapes-sides-and-corners sorting-shapes (sort by a stated rule, one rule at a time) and grade 4 sorting-quadrilaterals. Missing piece: "Карролл, Эйлер-Веннийн диаграмм хэрэглэн дүрслэх" — Carroll and Venn diagrams appear nowhere, and two-attribute classification is not formalized.

Collecting/recording data, tables, pictographs, bar graphs with differing scales, and simple line graphs taught in grade 5 data-and-graphs (tally-charts-and-tables, pictographs, bar-graphs, line-graphs) plus grade 4 data-and-pictographs. Missing piece: "дугуй диаграммыг унших" — pie charts appear only in a fun-fact about their inventor, never as a reading skill.
Grade 5 data-and-graphs mean-and-range teaches the arithmetic mean (арифметик дундаж) and the range (далайц) directly.

Possible/impossible events via observation/experiment and hypothesis testing ("боломжтой, боломжгүй үзэгдлийг тогтоох, таамаглал дэвшүүлэн шалгах") — no probability/chance content exists anywhere in grades 3-5; 'impossible' hits are casual phrasing in grade 3 data lessons.
Counting the number of possibilities ("боломжийн тоог тооцоолох") — no outcome-counting/combinatorics content anywhere in grades 3-5.

coverage.summary: Of the ministry's 28 grade-5 objectives, 8 are covered, 11 partial, and 9 missing: the whole-number, decimal, fraction, measurement-conversion, triangle-angle, and mean/range core is solidly taught, but the distinctly grade-5 strands — negative numbers, percent, ratio/proportion/scale, volume of cuboids, coordinates and plan drawings, translation/rotation transformations, Carroll/Venn diagrams, and probability/outcome counting — are absent, with Roman numerals, unlike-denominator fraction arithmetic, divisibility rules/common divisors, inequalities, pie charts, and hectare/km² area units as named gaps inside otherwise-taught objectives. Wherever an objective is taught, it lives overwhelmingly in PLATFORM grade 5 (whole-numbers-and-place-value, addition-and-subtraction, multiplication-and-division, fractions-first-steps, decimals-first-steps, measurement-and-units, geometry-shapes-and-area, data-and-graphs), with grade 4 supplying only the calendar, 3-D solids, line-symmetry, and number-pattern support and grade 3 only basic sorting. In effect the platform's grade 5 is where ministry grade 5's content lives, but it tops out at roughly the ministry's early-grade-5 arithmetic level, so closing the gap means adding the percent/ratio/negative-number/geometry-transformation/probability layer rather than relocating existing content.
